name: context_assemble
description: Assemble a read-only governed ContextECF context package with a synthetic assembled-context preview, selected sources, exclusions, metadata-only evidence references, sufficiency, gaps, package hash, and receipt metadata.

arguments.name: packId
arguments.desc: Public package id, such as support-sla-p1 or sales-renewal.

arguments.name: intentKind
arguments.desc: Public intent handle for the context request.

arguments.name: userRequest
arguments.desc: Natural language request describing the context needed.

arguments.name: timeWindow
arguments.desc: Lookback and lookahead window for the request.

arguments.name: sourceCapabilities
arguments.desc: Allowed source capability categories for the request.

name: context_explain
description: Explain public context package assembly metadata, including selected sources, exclusions, gaps, sufficiency, and policy references.

name: context_evidence
description: Return metadata for a public evidence reference without exposing source bodies.

arguments.name: context_package_id
arguments.desc: Context package id that owns the evidence reference.

name: context_feedback
description: Submit non-destructive metadata-only feedback about context package usefulness.
